data.one_liner: Dart library that parses source code into syntax‑highlighted HTML
data.what_it_does: The package tokenises source code and produces an HTML string with CSS classes for each token. It supports many languages and themes, and can be used in any Dart or Flutter project.
use_when: You need syntax highlighting for code snippets in a web or desktop app
You want a pure Dart solution without Flutter dependencies
You need to generate highlighted code for documentation or static sites
avoid_when: You need a Flutter widget that renders highlighted code directly
You require real‑time syntax highlighting in a text editor
strengths: Supports dozens of languages out of the box
Provides a core module for manual language registration
weaknesses: Only outputs HTML, not Flutter widgets
Limited to syntax highlighting, no editor features
